svg.title: NFE vs generated audio duration
svg.desc: NFE vs generated audio duration across 54 prompts at nine NFE values. Dots are prompt measurements, line is median, whiskers are IQR.
svg.text: dots.tts NFE benchmark: NFE vs generated audio duration
RTX 4090 x-vector full sweep. GPU model is run-owner reported; metadata records CUDA.
Generated clip length across prompts. Duration alone does not verify spoken content.
54 prompts • 9 NFE settings • 486 measured generations • one result per prompt/NFE • warmups excluded
dots.tts-soar • CUDA • bfloat16 • Euler • seed 42 • guidance 1.2 • speaker scale 1.5
Performance and clip duration only. These plots do not score transcript adherence or speech quality.
